A '''Stormdriver''' was a type of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] used during the [[Republic Dark Age]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord [[Zodoh]].

==Description==
Stormdrivers were equipped with several weaponized vaporators capable of generating downpours by squeezing moisture from the atmosphere. They were also equipped with defensive systems for countering [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] attacks.

==History==
During the [[Battle of Capital Cay]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], one Stormdriver was used to wreak havoc on Daiman's defense forces by creating atmospheric storms and floods which swept them into the sea. However, this vessel was destroyed by starfighters from [[Grace Command]]'s [[Devil Squadron]], an [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]]-based mercy organization affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Despite this, Zodoh gained enough data on [[Aquilaris Minor|Aquilaris']] atmospheric systems to launch the next phase of the [[Aquilaris campaign]]. This involved using a fleet of Stormdrivers to vaporize all mositure from Aquilaris' atmosphere and then create atmospheric storms which would flood the entire planet. Zodoh intended to use this new superweapon to browbeat his Sith competitors, particularly [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]], into submission.

During the [[Great Aquilaris Deluge]], the Stormdrivers flooded much of Aquilaris' surface but their operations were interrupted by a series of explosions which disrupted the data processing center on ''[[Voracious]]'', Zodoh's flagship. Despite this, Zodoh regarded his operation on Aquilaris as a success and deployed his fleet of Stormdrivers on [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]], the capital of Daiman's [[Daimanate|realm]]. Again, the Stormdrivers wrecked havoc on Darkknell but their operations were again disrupted by the destruction of the ''Voracious'' by two of Zodoh's opponents: [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] and [[Grace Command]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jenn Devaad]]. Following the [[Battle of Darkknell]], the Stormdrivers presumably retreated or were captured by Daiman's defense force. A modified Stormdriver's vaporator was later used by Daiman to execute Zodoh, who wanted to mend the humiliation of temporarily being rendered impotent.
